name: the evidence gate treats a completion flipped over an in_progress invocation as a contradiction
description: Step 1 is marked `- [x]` while the loom-invocation block bound to its anchor still reads `status: in_progress` -- the exact shape the evidence gate fires on. `/override` resolves that binding synchronously and records `evidence.override` with the invocation status it found, so this asserts the gate's predicate, its anchor binding, and its default mode without an LLM call. Step 2 has no bound invocation and must stay untouched: the gate has no opinion about a step it isn't holding, and neither does the override.
